## Flagship: NIH RePORTER pipeline

### Question
How many NIH projects use data science and AI methods each year, and where are they funded?

### Data
NIH RePORTER API (projects, abstracts, RCDC categories), FY2015 to FY2026. [Record counts and access date]{.todo}

### Method
- Paginated API pull with retries and rate limiting
- Cleaning: deduplicate by `appl_id`, standardize institute and activity codes, parse fiscal years
- Packaged as a module (`src/reporter.py`) with tests, so the SQL, ML, and NLP pages reuse the same data
